test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e666a901f5bdc3d0ea1b8c1f65c09ca6e3fde92cb9873642297a266447832890.png] 

Logic follows here is that the first letter is decreased by 5 and the second letter is increased by 3.

Option 1) SN-QU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb0ed3d01b809b0c90456cdd60b9c154b197fcef2a055fc2b760b0d8154783c5.png] 

Does not follow the same logic.

Option 2) UP-SV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfa3a72d3d749f1b118385591cfd57723e01b0f39bd1a9ece6a89d3d8d2fd81d.png] 

Option 3) QL-OR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62130f2647e577c51047a70711e926bf6ee6cb7aedf74a8290c1a30d67317c5f.png] 

Option 4) OJ-MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afb8097675856fcf5abf831f20286740749721028fbf94e276da4c22b3cbf751.png] 

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
